summary.intent: Continue executing a GSD-orchestrated multi-wave engine refactor (phase 70) for a subtree key-rotation/verification feature, progressing from plan 70-05 into 70-06.
summary.outcome: Plan 70-05 completed (verifySubtreeClean now recurses the full subtree with a key-bearing frontier, treating a missing root as dirty) with 44/44 engine tests passing and tsc baseline unchanged at 50; wave 3/6 closed out at 5/8 plans done, and wave 4/6 was dispatched with plan 70-06, the largest engine plan in the phase.

repo: tsc baseline error count is tracked as an invariant (currently 50) across plan executions in this engine refactor — plans must not change it.
verifySubtreeClean recursion requires a key-bearing frontier to walk the subtree; a missing root node is treated as a dirty state rather than an error.
workflow: This project uses a GSD phase/wave/plan hierarchy where each plan is dispatched to a subagent, and completion emits structured checkpoint messages (phase/wave progress, plan counts, test/tsc deltas, deviations).
Test-infra-only deviations (e.g., changing fixture child-kind to prevent infinite recursion) are called out explicitly in checkpoints and distinguished from assertion changes.

open_items: Frontier consumption (from 70-05's key-bearing frontier) deferred to plan 70-06 per the original plan.
Plan 70-06 is in progress: fresh-record resume gate, RootKeyStaleError, double-rotation handling, grantCallbacks threading, and fresh-copy return semantics.
